# tool: an independent tool computes the value

Each test runs one pinned external tool (pinned in `tools/requirements.txt`; adapters in
`src/mbqc_verify/tools/`) on the node's arguments and compares one value of its output with the claim. Expected
values come from the node, a frozen file already in the repository, or a held-out value only CI can read, never
from a proposer at run time. The tools' versions are recorded in the evidence. `dagtool tool NAME --args JSON`
runs a tool by hand.

Shared code: `_run.py` (running a tool, caching, the comparison).

<!-- tests:begin (generated by `dagtool readmes`; edit the test docstrings, not this table) -->
| Test | What it checks | A pass grants |
|---|---|---|
| [`tool/azure_re_logical_counts`](azure_re_logical_counts.py) | The Azure Quantum Resource Estimator, from the same logical counts, gives the claimed physical cost. | Empirical on the domain, or refuted. |
| [`tool/azure_re_qsharp`](azure_re_qsharp.py) | The Azure Quantum Resource Estimator, run on a Q# program, gives the claimed physical cost. | Empirical on the domain, or refuted. |
| [`tool/gridsynth_rz`](gridsynth_rz.py) | Ross–Selinger synthesis gives the claimed T count for Rz rotations at precision ε. | Empirical on the domain, or refuted. |
| [`tool/qualtran_cost`](qualtran_cost.py) | Qualtran's independent count of T, Toffoli, rotation and qubit costs for a bloq agrees with the claim. | Empirical on the domain, or refuted. |
| [`tool/surface_code_fit`](surface_code_fit.py) | A threshold-model fit to surface-code simulations agrees with a claimed κ or p_th. | Empirical on the domain, or refuted. |
| [`tool/surface_code_memory`](surface_code_memory.py) | Stim + PyMatching estimate the logical error rate of one rotated surface-code memory experiment. | Empirical on the domain, or refuted. |
<!-- tests:end -->
